profile: Higher-education architect, large. Knows every campus in the state and assumes that means it knows who has run a thermal network on one.

projects.title: Whitmore Science Quadrangle Renewal
projects.narrative: Deep renewal of three teaching and research buildings around a quadrangle, delivered term by term with students in residence.

projects.title: Auralia State Student Union
projects.narrative: Student union replacement with dining, assembly and study commons at the head of the campus green.

projects.title: Riverside College Residence Halls
projects.narrative: Two residence halls with 480 beds, seminar rooms and a shared dining commons.

projects.title: Whitmore Engineering Teaching Block
projects.narrative: Engineering teaching block with high-bay labs, classrooms and a maker floor.

projects.title: Calder Central Library
projects.narrative: Central library with open stacks, a children's wing and a community meeting suite.

projects.title: Calder Municipal Recreation Centre
projects.narrative: Recreation centre with a natatorium served by a heat recovery chiller plant and a dehumidification loop.

projects.title: Auralia State Athletics Complex
projects.narrative: Athletics complex with a fieldhouse, training rooms and spectator seating.

projects.title: Northgate School District Modernisation
projects.narrative: Modernisation of four school buildings, including classroom daylighting and envelope repairs.

projects.title: Community College Health Sciences Campus
projects.narrative: Health sciences campus with teaching clinics, simulation suites and a student services concourse.

projects.title: Confidential Institutional Programme
projects.narrative: Institutional campus programme delivered under a confidentiality agreement; the institution, the sites and the programme cannot be described to a third party.

people.bio: Mechanical lead for heat pump plant, heat recovery chillers and low-temperature hot water conversion in existing buildings.

people.name: Wren Ashby

people.bio: Project manager for municipal civic and recreation projects.
